market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from oil-driven inflation, bond sell-off, and rate-hike fears. Expect volatility in ^AXJO and ^AORD. Coal and energy names outperform; banks, REITs, and property-linked stocks underperform. Qantas strike and CSL deal add idiosyncratic risk. 1–3 month outlook: cautious, range-bound with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook hinges on RBA policy path, property credit recovery, and global AI/tech cycle. Coal and energy remain structurally supported. CSL US deal may prove marginally negative but long-term franchise intact. Renewables and gold offer diversification. Per capita recession risk caps upside for consumer and banks.
